title: Aesop's Fables, Volume 12 (Fables 276-284) - Grief and His Due
summary:
Aesop's Fables, Volume 12 (Fables 276-284) by . Dating back to the 6th century BC, Aesop's Fables tell universal truths through the use of simple allegories that are easily understood. Though almost nothing is known of Aesop himself, and some scholars question whether he existed at all, these stories stand as timeless classics known in almost every culture in the world. This is volume 12 of 12.
